statements.text: When Amazon trades at its all-time high on rising volume, the price rose in 90 % of 10 independent cases within 2 trading days.
When Amazon trades about 4 % below its all-time high inside a sideways phase on rising volume, the price rose in 88 % of 8 independent cases within one trading day.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Amazon came back every time: in all 5 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 27 months at most.
After a fall of 30 % from its all-time high, Amazon came back every time: in all 3 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 23 months at most.
